title: A finite projective module is finitely presented
statement: Let $A$ be a ring and $M$ an $A$-module which is finitely generated [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and projective [def-weil-pbc-projective-module]. Then $M$ is finitely presented: there is an exact sequence $A^{\oplus m}\to A^{\oplus n}\to M\to0$ of $A$-modules for some integers $m,n\ge0$.

source.place: Lemma Tag 00NX (lemma-finite-projective, line 19027), proof, implications (2)$\Rightarrow$(3)$\Rightarrow$(1): a surjection $R^n\to M$ splits, its kernel $K$ is a direct summand of $R^n$ hence finitely generated, so $M=R^n/K$ is finitely presented (lines 19064-19072)
